sentences.ar: واحد جاره سأل جحا: إمتى بتخلص الشغلة؟
sentences.en: A neighbour asked Juha: when will the work be finished?
The neighbour said: this is two days of work!

sentences.ar: قال جحا: كل إشي حلو بده تسع شهور.
sentences.en: Juha said: everything good needs nine months.
